How it works

From the moment you choose a product, to the moment it reaches your child.

1

Choose a product

A story, stickers or a notebook cover — each has its own options.

2

Tell us about your child

Their name, their age where the product needs it, and anything that matters to you.

3

Upload their photo

One clear photo is enough. We use it only to prepare the order.

4

Choose their favourite world

A cartoon character, sport, princesses, space… or ask for something specific.

5

We design it

We prepare the artwork by hand, around your child.

6

We coordinate approval, payment & delivery

We send the design for review on WhatsApp and agree the details with you.

7

We print and deliver

Once you approve, we print and prepare it for delivery.

Design review and approval happen over WhatsApp before printing, so what arrives is what you hoped for.
Production usually takes 2–5 days
That’s the time to make and prepare your order. Delivery time is separate and is arranged with you based on your location.
We use your child’s photo only to prepare your order, and never for marketing without your permission.
